.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (line 28 shaped reward behind gates and functional floor)
evidence: Reasoned each floor case through the frozen pipeline (paths relative to .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r4/task). Plumbing: test.sh:60 writes the zero record first; test.sh:68-70 zeroes a missing /app/server.js; test.sh:123-125 zeroes an app that never answers HTTP; test.sh:213-222 stops after a gate failure (score.py exit 1) or writes zero on a scorer error. score.py:41,47-48 gives reward 0.0 unless both gates are >0 and functional > floor 0.05 (scoring.toml:1-11, gates 0.0, weights 0.6/0.2/0.2). (1) Blank page / health-only server: passes readiness probe but render gate (gates/render/judge.toml:26-33) requires a real Kittle & Rowe matter chat, rejection of a wrong password and Gwen's matters and messages -> 0 -> reward 0. (2) Static mock / client-only fake (fake JS auth, seed data baked in, localStorage posts): may survive render, but constraints gate (gates/constraints/judge.toml:26-36) requires a post in M-11 to survive reload and appear for harriet@kittle.test in a separate browser context; Playwright runs --isolated and app_context.md:24 mandates a new context, so client storage cannot pass -> reward 0. (3) Seed copy: a server that just renders seed data with no write path fails the constraints persistence step; a seed copy plus a trivial shared post store passes the gates but then faces 16 functional criteria (total weight 33, so the 0.05 floor needs >=1.65 weight, i.e. one full >=2.0 criterion or two 1.5 ones). Every criterion needs real features with positive controls: e.g. persistence (functional judge.toml:255-265) needs a reply JUDGE-S1 found by search after restart; signin_and_client_scope needs mentions and search requests; sent_once_in_order needs replay idempotency and search; walls, timers, holds, edits each need their control. A chat-only app scores 0 functional -> floor fails -> reward 0 despite any polish/visual craft. (4) Keyword-stuffed page (rendered 'On hold', '7 days', 'not available', 'edited' text everywhere): fails constraints without a real write path; if it has one, functional criteria grade behaviour (disappearance, refusal paired with success, cross-context visibility, restart durability), not text, so stuffing earns nothing and the floor zeroes polish/visual stuffing (polish timer_label/hold_mark would otherwise reward static text). All prompts carry the untrusted-submission line and the in-dimension global gate rejecting 'static mock, static shell, missing backend, or seeded-looking facade' (functional prompt.md:11-19, polish prompt.md:10-18, visual prompt.md:18-26). (5) Refuse-everything submission: render gate requires Gwen's sign-in to succeed -> 0. Even if a gate slipped, functional prompt.md:47-48 and constraints prompt.md:47-49 require each refusal to pair with a positive control, so refusals earn no credit. Off-origin/CDN: integration.md:3 permits external assets, task.toml network_mode public, and every gate/global-gate prompt says CDN requests are not a failure, so a conforming CDN-using app is not floored. Conforming alternative: a legitimate app that implements features differently (any routes/cookies, functional prompt.md:58) clears gates and the low 0.05 floor; no hidden route or same-origin requirement found in gate text. Plausible broken app checked: a chat with sign-in, posting, replies and search but none of the legal features could pass persistence (2.0) and perhaps nested_replies (1.5): functional ~0.106 clears the floor and polish/visual add up to 0.4. That is a genuinely partial working app, not a shell/mock/stuffing case, so it is outside this row (relevant to ranking/discrimination rows 40/42/44 only). Risk=true because the raw evidence index (scope line) states full configured grading, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent: no shell/mock/stuffed/refusing app has been run through the configured LLM judges, so the floor conclusion rests on source reasoning about judge compliance with the gate text, not on measured rewards.
